product.title: Oahu: Ka Moana Lūʻau at Aloha Tower – Oceanfront Luau Show

description.text: Ka Moana Luau is an oceanfront show at Aloha Tower, with cultural activities, a Hawaiian buffet, and fire dance. Activities include making a coconut headband, stringing a flower lei, and hula. The buffet includes kalua pork, huli huli chicken, and lomi lomi salmon. The performance includes Polynesian fire dance. The headband, lei, and hula come before that fire dance and buffet at Aloha Tower in Honolulu. Lomi lomi salmon joins kalua pork and huli huli chicken on the Aloha Tower buffet before the fire dance.
